iris_vaughn.name: Iris Vaughn
iris_vaughn.ethnicity: Mixed Filipina-American (mother Filipina, father white American)

physical_description.build: slim, small-boned, calloused hands, slight stoop from carrying camera gear
physical_description.skin: light brown, freckles across the nose
physical_description.hair: black, straight, shoulder-length, tied back with a leather cord
physical_description.face: oval, strong jaw, small scar on right eyebrow from a childhood fall
physical_description.distinguishing_features: small lighthouse-silhouette tattoo inside left wrist (got it at 19, after her aunt's first winter on the island)

costumes.arrival: olive field jacket, grey wool sweater, dark jeans, brown leather boots, canvas camera bag
costumes.daily_work: aunt's old navy wool lighthouse-keeper coat (too big in shoulders), grey sweater, jeans, rubber boots
costumes.lamp_room: navy wool coat, red knit cap, fingerless gloves
costumes.climax: navy wool coat over pyjamas, red knit cap, holding the brass crank handle

props_carried: medium-format film camera with leather strap (her aunt's Yashica)
skills: medium-format film photography and darkroom printing
the code Marisol taught her at twelve
hand-cranking the lens rotation and fog-signal cam
weaknesses: panic attacks in enclosed spaces (claustrophobia from being locked in a closet at age 5)
grief-fog (mother died at Iris's age 16, aunt at 21)
does not trust her own memory of conversations with her aunt
initially reluctant to write down things that frighten her
iris_vaughn.motivation: Prove her aunt's death was not an accident; honor her aunt by acting, not by grieving.
iris_vaughn.stakes: Her life; her identity; her memory of her aunt.
iris_vaughn.arc: From grieving niece hiding in her aunt's coat → careful reader of her aunt's code → proactive investigator → decisive actor who hand-cranks the fog-signal whistle and confronts Renner on the dock.
iris_vaughn.voice: Sparse, specific, present-tense, addressed (silently) to her dead aunt.

marisol_vaughn.name: Marisol Vaughn
marisol_vaughn.role: Deceased aunt / second narrator (via journals read by Iris)

physical_description.build: stockier than Iris, the build of a woman who has carried rope and water for twenty years
physical_description.skin: deeply tanned and weathered, lighter brown than Iris
physical_description.hair: black, streaked grey, usually in a braid
physical_description.distinguishing_features: tattoo of an anchor on her left forearm (Coast Guard veteran)

marisol_vaughn.costumes_in_flashback: navy lighthouse-keeper coat, dark trousers, fisherman's sweater, rubber boots
skills: saltwater photography with an old Yashica medium-format
the private code she taught Iris at 12
marisol_vaughn.appearance_in_film: Present only via: (a) voice in journals read by Iris, (b) one photograph on the cottage wall, (c) two flashback scenes (teaching Iris the code at 12; braiding onion tops in the kitchen), (d) her coat, her tools, her handwriting on the keeper's log.

halen_yoo.name: Halen Yoo

physical_description.build: compact, wiry, strong shoulders from line work
physical_description.hair: very short, bleached almost white by sun
physical_description.face: sharp, with a way of speaking that never invites an answer

halen_yoo.costumes: foul-weather gear (yellow oilskin jacket and trousers over a grey sweater), knit watchman's cap, rubber deck boots
halen_yoo.props: the Petrel (a 32-foot wooden-hulled supply boat with a diesel engine)
skills: knows all four lights she services
halen_yoo.secret: Knew Marisol suspected Renner. Has known since the third keeper died in 2007. Has been silent out of fear.
halen_yoo.arc: From wary ally (act 1) → warns Iris off (act 2) → confesses and commits (act 3) → returns in the storm (climax) → holds Iris at the dock (resolution).
halen_yoo.agency: HIGH. She chooses to come back in the storm.

wren_delacroix.name: Wren Delacroix

physical_description.face: tidy, with a smile that does not always reach the eyes

wren_delacroix.costumes: Service uniform: navy windbreaker with a lighthouse-service patch, dark trousers, deck boots, a clipboard, a service cap
wren_delacroix.logic: Was paid badly for thirty years; the service stopped funding the lights; the smuggling money kept her lights running.
wren_delacroix.midpoint_role: She quotes a line from the hidden notebook to Iris — proving she has read the notebook and is therefore complicit.
wren_delacroix.climax_role: She does not appear at the climax; she is arrested off-screen.

otis_renner.name: Otis Renner

physical_description.build: tall, broad in the shoulder, with a fisherman's rolling walk

otis_renner.costumes: yellow fisherman's rain slicker over a heavy sweater, dark rubber boots, a knit cap
otis_renner.props: a length of pipe (the murder weapon); a flashlight; a gasoline-engine skiff
otis_renner.logic: The route fed his family for forty years. The service took the lighthouse and broke the deal. He is restoring the deal.
otis_renner.appearance: Mostly unseen until the climax. We see him as: (a) a figure at the dock in Marisol's photograph (midpoint), (b) a silhouette at the dock through rain (climax), (c) sitting on the dock cleat at dawn (post-climax).
otis_renner.agency_at_climax: Surrenders without resistance when the Coast Guard arrives; admits his crimes calmly.

ed_bose.name: Ed Bose
ed_bose.role: Shortwave mentor / retired keeper on the mainland
ed_bose.appearance: Voice only (shortwave). Never seen on screen. The coda's recipient of Iris's postcard.

female_agency_summary.iris: Protagonist. Decisive at midpoint, climax, and resolution.
female_agency_summary.marisol: Dead but drives the entire plot through her journals and her bookmarked keeper's manual page.
female_agency_summary.halen: Saves Iris by returning in the storm.
female_agency_summary.wren: Antagonist. Has her own logic and her own arc (arrest off-screen).
